settings.initial_output_policy: All FOMs return the exact supplied requested-grid initial field at t=0. Host coarse restriction, coarse GPU input, all later-time interpolation, GPU-to-host transfer and full contiguous host output construction are charged. ROM returns its actual fitted initial field and charges full-input transfer/projection/fit and all full host outputs.
settings.interpolation: Physically aligned piecewise bilinear on interior nodes i/N with exact homogeneous boundary values; no pixel-center resizing.

query_contract: All FOMs return the exact supplied requested-grid initial field at t=0. ROM returns its actual fitted initial field and charges full-input transfer/projection/fit and all full host outputs.
boundary_policy: Full interior arrays returned; all boundary nodes identically zero for both methods.
